newsitem.title: UK: Cookson plans disposals, possible buys.
newsitem.headline: Cookson plans disposals, possible buys.

text.p: British electronic, ceramic and plastic industrial materials company Cookson Group Plc is considering more disposals to help fund growth and make possible acquisitions in the Asian-Pacific region and Europe, a company source said on Thursday.

"There is a possibility of more disposals, perhaps one or two, and that would give a cash mountain over the next four years of over 500 million stg to help grow the businesses worldwide," the source said.

"Acquisitions would be across the board but with an eye to expanding geographically in the Asia-Pacific region and Europe. It would go across all divisions but primarily electronics materials and ceramics," the source said.
Cookson earlier on Thursday said it expected to resume earnings growth this year. The company has pushed through a major restructuring and had sold its loss-making businesses.
